about: The QR text printed on every Mule City paper (MuleCity-dykb, docs/erpnext/scan-redesign-design.md A1). Shared by the app (scan_code.scan_url, tests/test_scan_url.py, mulecity_erpnext.tests.test_scan_router) and the XPOS fork (frontend/src/services/scanCode.ts scanUrl, scanCode.spec.ts): both sides must produce exactly these strings. url = base without its trailing slash + '/s/' + alias + '/' + quote(name). quote: percent-encode UTF-8 bytes except A-Z a-z 0-9 and the characters in 'safe' (Python urllib.parse.quote(name, safe=safe); in JS, encodeURIComponent(name) then decode %XX back for each character in safe that encodeURIComponent escapes, and escape ! ' ( ) * only if not in safe). This is frappe.utils.quoted's safe set without '/', '?' and '#', which would break a name inside a path.
